name: azure-advisor-grpo-benchmark
description:
Azure Advisor GRPO Benchmark Dataset
	

Evaluation benchmark for measuring the quality of Azure Advisor recommendation generation, used for GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization) training and model evaluation.

	
		
		Dataset Description
	

This dataset contains 106 evaluation examples with ground truth labels, designed to score model outputs across 5 reward dimensions.

	
		
		Purpose
	


During GRPO training: Score generated recommendations to select high-reward samples
Model… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/thegovind/azure-advisor-grpo-benchmark.
evaluation_method: composite reward score (human-annotated labels across 5 reward dimensions)
reputation: A small, specialized evaluation set used for GRPO training and reward-model evaluation within Azure Advisor research; limited public adoption outside that context.
